But many have yet to encounter dip hop. In 2020,
dip hop artist Sean Forbes’s “Little Victories” reached
number one in hip hop on iTunes; in 2021, Wawa’s
“LOUD” was a Top 20 dance track; and in 2022, both
artists performed in the Super Bowl Halftime Show,
bringing dip hop to the masses.
